Enable multi-agent V2 and Ultra reasoning on Amazon Bedrock (#49345)

## What changed

Preserve catalog `multi_agent_version` values instead of forcing V1, allowing models that declare V2 to use it by default. Retain Ultra in supported reasoning levels so it appears in the Astra advanced reasoning picker for Bedrock Mantle and Runtime.

## Testing

Add coverage for preserving configured multi-agent versions, selecting V2 and exposing `collaboration.spawn_agent` and `collaboration.followup_task` without the V2 feature flag, and displaying and selecting Ultra in both Bedrock reasoning pickers.

head_commit.message:
Clean up canceled exec-server RPC requests immediately (#49332)

## Why

Canceled RPC calls could leave entries in the pending request map until further traffic or disconnect. Cleanup should happen when the call is dropped, even if no response arrives.

## What changed

Use a `PendingRequestGuard` to remove each registration when its call completes or is canceled. Protect the pending map with a synchronous mutex so cleanup can run in `Drop`, replacing opportunistic pruning and explicit error-path removals.

## Testing

Add a regression test that drops an in-flight call and verifies that the pending request count immediately reaches zero without further traffic.

head_commit.message:
Clean up canceled exec-server RPC requests immediately (#49332)

## Why

Canceled RPC calls could leave entries in the pending request map until further traffic or disconnect. Cleanup should happen when the call is dropped, even if no response arrives.

## What changed

Use a `PendingRequestGuard` to remove each registration when its call completes or is canceled. Protect the pending map with a synchronous mutex so cleanup can run in `Drop`, replacing opportunistic pruning and explicit error-path removals.

## Testing

Add a regression test that drops an in-flight call and verifies that the pending request count immediately reaches zero without further traffic.
